name: Muhammad ibn Muhsin Abu Raqaba
bio: Muhammad ibn Muhsin Abu Raqaba writes teaching poems on the life of the Prophet and the study of the Quran. In one he gives the horses remembered in the early biographies a name and a distinguishing story. In another he casts a lesson about divisions of the Quran as a conversation with a young reader. Khalid al-Sharafi recorded both for Alqimmah Studio.
